cases.title: Approval snapshots server and tool definitions
cases.when: An admin imports a remote MCP server
then: serverInfo, TLS SPKI pin and a definition digest per tool are recorded

cases.title: The model sees only the approved snapshot
then: tools/list still shows the approved description

cases.title: A definition change quarantines the tool
cases.when: The upstream changes a tool schema and a refresh runs
then: The tool is quarantined and calls are blocked; an alert is raised

cases.title: A server swap is detected
cases.when: The upstream presents a different SPKI, then a changed serverInfo name, then a new version
then: SPKI or name change: the whole server is quarantined

cases.title: Unapproved upstream tools are never exposed
cases.when: The upstream adds a tool and renames another
then: Neither appears; calls go only to approved upstream names

cases.title: Arguments and results are validated against the snapshot
cases.when: The upstream returns a result violating outputSchema
then: The result is blocked, the tool quarantined and an alert raised

cases.title: Freshness follows min(ttlMs, 60 s) and toolsListChanged
cases.when: The upstream advertises ttlMs 300000, then sends toolsListChanged
then: Refresh at 60 s and on the notification

cases.title: Strict mode fetches tools/list per call
cases.when: Strict mode is on and a call is made
then: A fresh tools/list precedes the call

cases.title: CONNECTION profiles intersect approved and live lists
cases.when: A user's live list lacks one approved tool
then: That tool is not available to that user

cases.title: Results are marked untrusted
then: _meta io.toolgate/untrusted-upstream is set and the content never enters descriptions

cases.title: Upstream input_required is forwarded only if policy allows
cases.when: The upstream returns input_required with elicitation allowed and not allowed

cases.title: Upstream task handles are wrapped
then: The client gets a ToolGate task; the upstream handle is never exposed

cases.title: Discovery falls back to the legacy probe in the client role
then: The proxy discovers it with initialize
